nodes.description: CRISPR knock-ins of the three patient CIAO1 residues, which are invariant between the nematode and human. All three are viable with normal brood size and hatch rate under standard conditions, where a knockout is sterile, and all three show reduced embryonic viability on fluoropyrimidine exposure: the two rare alleles retain about 40 percent hatching, while the p.Arg71Trp line is as severely affected as a dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase knockout. The p.Arg71Trp line also has a temperature-dependent mortal germline phenotype, becoming sterile over generations at the higher temperature, which is the only allele-specific fitness defect reported and sits on the allele shared by both human presentations. The drug assay needs a bacterial food strain unable to convert the drug itself, since the usual strain's own metabolism masks the host defect.

nodes.description: Without the targeting complex, cytosolic and nuclear apoproteins that depend on it do not acquire their clusters and are degraded. The clients PMID:38950322 reports compromised are dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase, DNA polymerase delta (POLD1, with reduced 55Fe incorporation), RTEL1, ELP3, CDKAL1 and PPAT; the reduction in ERCC2 (XPD) is read off that paper's immunoblot panel rather than stated in its text. How far this generalizes is disputed, and the disagreement is recorded on the DNA replication node below. The defect is selective: cytosolic aconitase (IRP1) activity, cellular iron homeostasis and mitochondrial iron content are normal, which separates this disorder from the early mitochondrial assembly defects with mitochondrial iron overload. Lentiviral CIAO1 restores the client proteins in patient cells.

nodes.description:
In the PMID:38950322 patients, POLD1, the catalytic subunit of DNA polymerase delta, fails to incorporate its cluster, and RTEL1 is reduced. Patient fibroblasts in both reports proliferate more slowly than control cells. How this contributes to the clinical phenotype is inferred rather than shown.
The two primary reports disagree here, and this is the entry's main unresolved discrepancy. PMID:38411040 found the protein levels of POLD1, XPD and PPAT unchanged in its own patients' fibroblasts, with only ETFDH, ABCE1 and CDK5RAP3 altered among detected iron-sulfur proteins. The readouts are not the same measurement - PMID:38950322 reports radiolabelled iron incorporation into POLD1 as well as steady-state levels in two patients, PMID:38411040 reports steady-state expression in two different patients - so a cluster-loading defect without a measurable fall in protein abundance would reconcile them. That reconciliation is offered as a reconciliation, not as a finding: neither paper tests it.

nodes.description: Patient fibroblasts are broadly remodeled rather than selectively altered: 283 of 2,347 quantified proteins and 779 of 2,047 lipid species change, with polyunsaturated long-chain phosphatidylcholines increased, and labelled-substrate work shows altered flux through the citric acid cycle and the methionine-cysteine pathway. How it produces the clinical phenotype is not established.
